pet_notes: Default is a plump sleeping white cat lying to the left of a tall railway signal. Signal stays on SCREEN RIGHT in every animation and look pose, height about 1.6 times resting cat height, exactly red top green middle blue bottom. The pair is one compact pet identity; no cushion or extra props. Blue light idle and look directions, green working and review, red failed and waiting. Keep entire cat and signal within every frame with transparent padding. Eyes when awake are natural small dark feline eyes, not googly. Cardinal gaze changes head/nose/ears naturally while the lying body and signal stay anchored. Jumping must visibly lift the entire pair above baseline then land, with cat doing a small cheerful hop and signal accompanying the mascot as a floating magical prop for that short action; no detached effects. Running-left must not mirror the signal placement.
style_notes: Approved softly hand-painted fluffy pure-white cat, delicate charcoal pencil contours and gentle Japanese fantasy-animation charm. Keep the exact face, ears, long wrapped tail, white fur, and tall vintage charcoal railway signal from the reference.
